commons_claim: Drel hunts Cassik when temperature is at most 20°C AND drel_density is at least 35; otherwise it does not hunt.
evidence_summary: All six confirmed observations fit this rule exactly: 20/35 and 19/44 and 18/40 are hunted; 20/28, 21/60, and 22/70 are not.
